headline: ANGLO-CODELCO SEAL $5B LOS BRONCES-ANDINA MERGER — 2.7Mt EXTRA COPPER OVER 21 YEARS, NO NEW MINE NEEDED
snippet: Anglo American and Codelco finalized on June 24, 2026 their definitive agreement to integrate the mine plans for their adjacent Los Bronces and Andina copper operations in Chile's central Andes, unlocking 2.7 million additional tonnes of copper over 21 years — approximately 120,000 t/year incremental production split equally between both companies — with at least US$5 billion in pre-tax value. No new mine licence is required, as the agreement optimises sequencing, infrastructure, and development across already-permitted ground, with full implementation contingent on environmental permits and scheduled for 2030.

headline: GOLD CLAWS BACK ABOVE $4,000 AS BARGAIN BUYING RETURNS — SILVER RECOVERS 1.6% AFTER FOUR-SESSION SELLOFF
snippet: After breaking below US$4,000 for the first time in months on June 24, spot gold steadied back above the threshold on June 25 — trading near $4,013–$4,040 and up 0.36–1.02% on the session — as the in-line May PCE print (4.1% YoY, 3.4% core) removed the upside inflation surprise needed to sustain the selloff, enabling pent-up bargain buying to emerge despite the U.S. dollar holding near a one-year high. Silver recovered 1.4–1.6% to near $58.13–$58.77, though CME FedWatch held the September rate-hike probability steady at approximately 68%, keeping the recovery tentative.

headline: PIRATE GOLD MOBY DICK SPREADS 1.8KM — COPPER CONFIRMED 1,700M EAST OF DISCOVERY; 50,000M PROGRAM (TSXV:YARR)
source_name: Investing News Network / Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV:YARR)
snippet: Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV:YARR) announced June 25 that step-out holes PGC-26-118 (100m west of initial discovery) and PGC-26-120 (1,700m east) both returned visible chalcopyrite mineralisation in core, extending the Moby Dick discovery — first reported June 17 with 0.54% CuEq over 180.8m including 1.48% CuEq over 49.4m — to an interpreted 1.8km east-west trend within a confirmed 3,100m × 850m × 500m advanced argillic alteration system at the Treasure Island Project in Central Newfoundland. Two rigs are active in a 50,000m program; assays from both step-out holes are pending.

headline: Q2 METALS FIRES UP 20,000m AT CISCO — 295Mt LITHIUM RESOURCE ADVANCING TO PEA, FOUR DRILLS MOBILIZING (TSXV:QTWO)
snippet: Q2 Metals Corp. (TSXV:QTWO) announced June 25 the commencement of its 2026 summer drill program at the Cisco Lithium Project in Quebec's James Bay region, with two diamond drill rigs on site and two more being mobilized to run approximately 20,000m of infill drilling. The program targets conversion of the April 2026 295-million-tonne Inferred Mineral Resource to Indicated classification — the precondition for the company's first Preliminary Economic Assessment, which is targeted for late 2026. Environmental baseline studies initiated in May 2026 signal a project advancing simultaneously on exploration, economics, and permitting fronts.

headline: ENERGY FUELS HITS FULL-YEAR URANIUM TARGET BY MID-JUNE — WHITE MESA 1.6M LBS; HEAVY REE CIRCUITS START JULY (UUUU)
source_name: Mining.com / Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) announced June 25 that uranium oxide production at White Mesa Mill in Utah is on track to reach 1.6 million lb. U₃O₈ by June 30 — meeting the company's full-year 2026 guidance range of 1.5–2.5 million pounds at just the halfway point of the year. The mill will then pause uranium processing to rebuild ore stockpiles and, starting in July 2026, commence circuit modifications to enable commercial production of heavy rare earth elements — samarium, europium, gadolinium, terbium, and dysprosium — positioning White Mesa as the only facility in the Western world capable of processing both uranium and a full suite of rare earth oxides under one roof.

headline: FOX TUNGSTEN LAUNCHES 20,000m DRILL AT BC PROJECT — 60% FOR RESOURCE/PEA, SILVERBOSS Mo TARGETS ADDED (TSXV:FOXT)
snippet: Fox Tungsten Corp. (TSXV:FOXT) announced June 25 the mobilisation of the first of two diamond drill rigs to its Fox Project — approximately 75km northeast of 100 Mile House, British Columbia — initiating a fully-funded 20,000m drill program running through October 2026. Approximately 60% targets resource expansion across the BN, RC, and BK zones to support an updated mineral resource estimate and Preliminary Economic Assessment in H1 2027, 30% tests new tungsten discovery targets at Fox North and the August Showing, and 10% evaluates copper-molybdenum potential at the adjacent Silverboss property near Glencore's decommissioned Boss Mountain mine. Tungsten is a NATO-listed critical mineral with more than 85% of global production concentrated in China.

headline: CANUC CRACKS 60.1 g/t GOLD OVER 0.9m AT EAST SUDBURY — FULL INTERCEPT 8.99 g/t OVER 9.2m WITH Cu-Ni-Co HALO (TSXV:CDA)
snippet: Canuc Resources Corp. (TSXV:CDA, OTCQB:CNUCF) reported June 25 from hole SM-26-148 at the Glade Zone 2.1 target of its East Sudbury Project in Ontario: 9.2 metres grading 8.99 g/t gold, including a 0.9-metre sub-interval at 60.10 g/t gold, approximately 1km south of the historical Scadding Gold Mines, within a polymetallic envelope also hosting copper, nickel, and cobalt mineralisation in the broader Glade Zone 2 corridor. The high-grade intercept extends a pattern of gold discoveries at the East Sudbury contact zone that has historically been overlooked in a region better known for its base metal endowment.

headline: KINGFISHER'S 2ND DRILL HITS HWY 37 — EXTENDING 425m BLIND PORPHYRY DISCOVERY HOLE; 3 RIGS, 15,000m (TSXV:KFR)
snippet: Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSXV:KFR) announced June 25 the arrival of its second of three planned diamond drills at the HWY 37 Project in British Columbia's Golden Triangle, with the rig collaring immediately in the Hank Porphyry target area. The first drill is extending discovery hole HW-25-011, which in 2025 intersected 425 metres of 0.15% Cu, 0.21 g/t Au, and 2.2 g/t Ag (0.40% CuEq) — confirming a blind copper-gold porphyry system beneath existing Hank gold-silver epithermal deposits — as part of a fully funded 15,000-metre 2026 program designed to delineate porphyry mineralisation and test additional discovery targets across the Hank-Mary District.

headline: K2 GOLD BREAKS GROUND AT CALIFORNIA MOJAVE — 5,650m EIS-APPROVED GOLD DRILL; DRAGONFLY HIGH-GRADE TARGET FIRST (TSXV:KTO)
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV:KTO, OTCQX:KTGDF) confirmed June 25 that drilling has commenced at its 100%-owned Mojave Project in Inyo County, California, under a fully permitted Environmental Impact Statement — an unusually difficult milestone to secure in California — with an initial 5,650-metre program beginning at the Dragonfly target, which hosts broad high-grade gold mineralisation from surface. The $9.8 million exploration budget covers up to 14,000 metres across the 5,830-hectare property and represents the first drilling campaign at a California gold project of this scale permitted under a completed EIS in this cycle.
